title: CardCorpus price history of a card
description: One card's daily `price` for each of its copies, from its first priced day to the newest. Served by index.json's `prices.history`, not in this tree; 404 for a card with none (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#prices).

card.description: The card's id in its set.

through.description: The newest day either marketplace has: where the history ends.

currency.description: The currency of each marketplace's series.

days.description: Every day from the card's first priced day through `through`, in order.

copies.description: Each copy that ever had a price, by copy id.

additionalProperties.description: The copy's series on each marketplace that priced it.

tcgplayer.description: The copy's `price` on TCGplayer, one entry per day of `days`.

items.description: The price that day, or null when it had none.

cardmarket.description: The copy's `price` on Cardmarket, one entry per day of `days`.

items.description: The price that day, or null when it had none.

change30d.description: How each copy's price moved over the last 30 days, by copy id.

additionalProperties.description: How the copy's price moved over 30 days on each marketplace, as a fraction: 0.045 is up 4.5%, 0 is less than 2% either way. A marketplace is left out when there is too little to compare.
